section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the findings regarding the Chinese BAS-2, confirming its single-factor structure in both women and men within a sample of university students from Hong Kong. The results are consistent with US findings but contrast with earlier Hong Kong work using the original BAS. The study highlights the importance of cross-cultural equivalence and reports higher body appreciation in their sample compared to North American adults. It also notes significant correlations between body appreciation and BMI in women and BMI2 in men, and higher body appreciation in men than women.
